Book I, Epigram 98: Ad Naevolum Causidicum
Naenia Upon the death of my dear friend T. S. Esquire, slain at the first fight at Newbery, 1645
Grub-street Nae Satire: An Answer to the Foregoing
O Jeanie, There 's Naething to Fear Ye
O Think nae mair o' Me, Sweet May!
Ye 'll Never Gang Back to Yer Mither Nae Mair
